notes:
ANALYST PASS (iteration 1)

1. Pass-rate axis saturated: all 17 assertions pass in both configurations. These tasks are within reach of a strong model with full tool access, so binary pass/fail does not separate the configs this round; cost and robustness do.

2. The dominant baseline failure mode is pre-empted by the skill: 3/3 baseline runs first hit the PyPI stale-JS trap (PyPI wheels ship an old renderer with no saveImage/cartoon draw path even at version 1.7.0) and had to discover the git-pin, the _display_viewer->HTML->Playwright->renderer.saveImage pipeline, and the JS-bridge gotchas by trial and error (~10+ commands, most of the run spent on discovery; e0-base self-reported ~15 min). With-skill runs followed the SKILL.md quick-start nearly verbatim and spent their effort on the scientific task instead (e.g. e1-with cross-checked pLDDT/PAE numbers against official AF v6 data).

3. The iteration's real yield is three concrete skill gaps found only by the with-skill runs: (a) saveImage exports only the structure canvas - PAE panels need --page; (b) --page captures include the interactive toolbar (needs a hide-chrome option); (c) recording duration is frame-driven (nFrames x max(50, animationSpeed) ms) and self-stops, so --seconds cannot set trajectory video length - a playback-speed flag is needed. All three are queued for iteration 2.

4. Timing/token columns are zero: runs were interrupted mid-flight by an API rate limit and resumed, so telemetry was not captured. Command counts from commands.log are the honest cost proxy this round.

5. Output cross-validation: both eval-1 runs independently identified the same confident/disordered regions of Q5VSL9 (matching UniProt disorder annotations), and both eval-2 videos verifiably animate - the deliverables themselves are sound.
